cohort: 120 term pregnant women (>=37 weeks) with singleton, cephalic fetuses, intact membranes, and a Bishop score <=6 with cervical dilatation <=2 cm, undergoing induction of labour at a tertiary hospital.
finding: The Levine calculator demonstrated good concordance between predicted and actual outcomes, proving an effective tool for predicting LSCS following induction of labour in women with unfavourable cervices.
mod_finding: The Levine calculator is an effective tool for predicting lower segment caesarean section (LSCS) following induction of labour in women with unfavourable cervices, with significant associations found between LSCS and Levine score >30%, nulliparity, BMI >30 kg/m2, and cervical dilatation <1 cm.
